title: Sergeant A J Smith and Short Stirling EF352
memorial_details: description: IN HONOUR OF/ 1852352/ RAF SGT A J SMITH/ OF HEDGE END/ THIS TREE WAS PLANTED ON THE/ 12TH NOVEMBER 1989 IN MEMORY/ OF SGT A J SMITH WHO AT 9:20 PM/ ON THE NIGHT OF 22ND OCTOBER/ 1943 ALONG WITH THE CREW OF/ STIRLING BOMBER E.F. 352 WHICH/ WAS ON FIRE GAVE THEIR LIVES IN/ SAVING THE VILLAGE AT PRESTON/ WYNNE HEREFORD BEFORE CRASHING WITH ALL LOSS OF LIFE/ LEAVING A WIDOW AND THREE SONS IN HEDGE/ END.
